title: Lower Leg Edema Evaluation After Total Knee Arthroplasty Using Bioimpedance
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the applicability and measurement properties of bioimpedance spectroscopy for postsurgical edema assessment after total knee arthroplasty
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* knee replacement surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* pacemaker
* cardiac defibrillator
* other metallic implant than knee arthroplasty
